texts: good. the habit parses as a fireable rule, with "often" carried both as the rule's strength and as the recorded quantifier word. The one thing not captured is the "all season long" force of "through" — summer is stored as a plain time slot — and no rewording carries that any better today.
good. each hunt derives its own accumulation of many feathers at the cliff base, tied to that hunt and deadlined by autumn, with nothing asserted unconditionally.
good. a fireable per-hunt rule; the three-word compound "autumn feather store" is kept whole as one kind with its "store" genus recorded.
